senses.gloss:
अनेक a.
—1 Not one; more than one, many; अनेकपितृकाणां तु पितृतो भागकल्पना
 Y. 2. 120, अनेकराजन्यरथाश्वसंकुलम् Ki. 1. 16; several, various;
 तथात्मैकोऽप्यनेकश्च Y. 3. 144.
[]
—2 Separated; divided; oft. in comp.; ˚आकार having many shapes or
 forms; diverse, multiform; ˚कालम् -वारम् several times, many a time
 and oft.; ˚भार्य having more wives than one.
.━{@Comp.@}: अनेकाक्षर, अनेकाच्, अनेकाग्र, अनेकान्त, अनेकार्थ, अनेकाल्, अनेकाश्रय, अनेकाश्रित, अनेककृत्, अनेकगुण, अनेकगुप्तः, अनेकगोत्र, अनेकचर, अनेकचित्त, अनेकज, अनेकपः, अनेकपद, अनेकभार्य, अनेकमुख, अनेकमूर्तिः, अनेकयुद्धविजयिन्, अनेकविजयिन्, अनेकरूप, अनेकलोचनः, अनेकवचनम्, अनेकवर्ण, अनेकविध, अनेकशफ, अनेकशब्द, अनेकसाधारण
अनेक + -अक्षर, -अच् a. having more than one vowel or syllable; polysyllabic.
अनेक + -अक्षर, -अच् a. having more than one vowel or syllable; polysyllabic.

अनेक + -अग्र a.
—1 engaged in several pursuits.
—2 not concentrated or fixed on one object.
—3 Agitated, perplexed^1; स त्वनेकाग्रहृदयो द्वास्थं प्रत्यर्च्य तं जनम्
 Rām. 2. 41. 34.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20251204. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/101.

अनेक + -अन्त a.
—1 [न˚ ब˚] not alone so as to exclude all others, uncertain,
 doubtful, variable; स्यादित्यव्ययमनेकान्तवाचकम्
—2 = अनैकान्तिक q. v.

अनेक + -अन्त + ({@-न्तः@})
—1 unsettled condition, absence of permanence.
—2 uncertainty, doubtfulness.
—3 an unessential part, as the several anubandhas.
अनेक + -अन्त + ˚वादः scepticism.
अनेक + -अन्त + ˚वादिन् m. a sceptic, a Jaina or an Arhat of the Jainas.

अनेक + -अर्थ a.
—1 having many (more than one) meanings, homonymous; as the words गो,
 अमृत, अक्ष &c.; ˚त्वम् Capacity to express more senses than one;
 अनेकार्थत्वमन्याय्यम् ŚB. on MS. 7. 3. 55. अनेकार्थस्य शब्दस्य K. P. 2.
—2 having the sense of the word अनेक.
—3 having many objects or purposes.
अनेक + -अर्थ + .({@-र्थः@}) multiplicity of objects, topics &c.
अनेक + -अल् a. having more than one अल् (letter) P. I. 1. 55.

अनेक + -आश्रय, -आश्रित a. (in Vaiś. Phil.) dwelling or abiding
 in more than one (such as संयोग, सामान्य); एतेऽनेकाश्रिता गुणाः
 Bhāṣā P.; dependence upon more than one.

अनेक + -आश्रय, -आश्रित a. (in Vaiś. Phil.) dwelling or abiding
 in more than one (such as संयोग, सामान्य); एतेऽनेकाश्रिता गुणाः
 Bhāṣā P.; dependence upon more than one.
अनेक + -कृत् m. ‘doing much’, N. of Śiva.
अनेक + -गुण a. of many kinds, manifold, diverse; विगणय्य कारणमनेकगुणम् Ki. 6. 37.
अनेक + -गुप्तः N. of a king; ˚अर्चितपादपङ्कजः K. 3.

अनेक + -गोत्र a. belonging to two families (such as a boy when adopted)
 i. e. that of his own, and that of his adoptive father.
अनेक + -चर a. gregarious.

अनेक + -चित्त a. not of one mind, fickle-minded; कच्चिन्नानेकचित्तानां
 तेषां त्वं वशमागतः Rām. 6. 24. 26.

अनेक + -चित्त + ˚मन्त्रः not following the
 counsels of one; H. 4. 31.
अनेक + -ज a. born more than once.
अनेक + -ज + .({@-जः@}) a bird (गर्भाण्डाभ्यां जातत्वात्).

अनेक + -पः an elephant (so called because he drinks with his trunk and
 mouth); cf. द्विप; वन्येतरानेकपदर्शनेन R. 5. 47; Śi. 5. 35, 12. 75.

अनेक + -पद a. multi-numbered; having many component members (as
 in a Bahuvrīhi compound). e. g. बृहद् अस्य रथन्तरसाम इति बृहद्रथन्तरसामा
 ŚB. on MS. 10. 6. 4.
अनेक + -भार्य a. Having more wives than one.

अनेक + -मुख a. (-खी f.)
—1 having many faces, many-faced.
—2 scattered, dispersed, going in various directions, taking to various
 ways; (बलानि) जगाहिरेऽनेकमुखानि मार्गान् Bk. 2. 54.

अनेक + -मूर्तिः ‘having many forms’, N. of Viṣṇu who assumed various
 forms to deliver the earth from calamities.
अनेक + -युद्धविजयिन्, -विजयिन् a. victorious in many battles; Pt. 3. 9, 11.
अनेक + -युद्धविजयिन्, -विजयिन् a. victorious in many battles; Pt. 3. 9, 11.

अनेक + -रूप a.
—1 of various forms, multiform.
—2 of various kinds or sorts.
—3 fickle, changeable, of a varying nature; वेश्याङ्गनेव नृपनीतिरनेकरूपा Pt. 1. 425.
अनेक + -रूप + .({@-पः@}) epithet of the Supreme Being.

अनेक + -लोचनः N. of Śiva; also of Indra, and of the Supreme Being,
 he being said to be सहस्राक्षः सहस्रपात् &c.
अनेक + -वचनम् the plural number; dual also.

अनेक + -वर्ण a. involving more than one (unknown) quantity
[]
 (the unknown quantities x. y. z. &c. being represented in Sanskrit
 by colours नील, काल &c.);
अनेक + -वर्ण + ˚समीकरणम् simultaneous equation;

अनेक + -वर्ण + ˚गुणनम्, ˚व्यवकलनम्, ˚हारः multiplication, subtraction or division
 of unknown quantities.

अनेक + -वर्ण + ˚गुणनम्, ˚व्यवकलनम्, ˚हारः multiplication, subtraction or division
 of unknown quantities.

अनेक + -वर्ण + ˚गुणनम्, ˚व्यवकलनम्, ˚हारः multiplication, subtraction or division
 of unknown quantities.
अनेक + -विध a. various, different.
अनेक + -शफ a. cloven-hoofed.
अनेक + -शब्द a. synonymous.
अनेक + -साधारण a. common to many, the common property of many persons Dk. 83.
अनेकधा ind. In various ways, variously; जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा Bg. 11. 13.

अनेकशः ind. [वीप्सार्थे कारके शस्]
—1 Several or many times, frequently; अनेकशो निर्जितराजकस्त्वम् Bk. 2. 52.
—2 In various ways or manners.
—3 In large numbers or quantities; पुत्रा अनेकशो मृता दाराश्च H. 1.
अनेकाकिन् a. Not alone, accompanied by.

अनेजत् a. [न एजत्] Not moving, immovable; of the same form,
 epithet of Brahman or the Supreme Soul (सर्वदैकरूपं ब्रह्म) अनेजदेकं
 मनसो जवीयः Īśop. 4.
अनेकीकृ or भू To make or be manifold; to divide or be divided into.
अनेकीकृ or भू To make or be manifold; to divide or be divided into.

अनेडः A foolish or stupid person, dolt, fool.
.━{@Comp.@}: अनेडमूक

अनेडः + -मूक a.
—1 deaf and dumb; ˚मूकताद्यैश्च द्यतु दोषैरसंमतान् K. P. 7.
—2 blind. cf. अन्धेऽप्यनेडमूकः स्यात् Nm.
—3 dishonest, fraudulent, wicked, perverse.

अनेद्य a. Ved.
—1 Not to be blamed; praiseworthy, chief (प्रशस्त, प्रधान).
—2 Not near; infinite.

अनेन a. Sinless, faultless (Sāy.); without a variegated set
 (of horses); अनेनो वो मरुतो यामो अस्तु Rv. 6. 66. 7.
अनेनस् a. Sinless, blameless; not liable to error.
अनेनः ‘One who has no superior’, a sovereign or paramount lord.
अनेमन् a. Ved. Praiseworthy.
अनेव ind. Otherwise; एवानेवाव सा गरत् Av. 16. 7. 4.

अनेहस् a. [न हन्यते, हन्-असि, धातोः एहादेशः नञि हन् एह
 च Uṇ. 4. 223] (lit.) Not killed or destroyed or obstructed; Ved. without
 a rival, incomparable, unattainable, inaccessible; unobstructed, not liable
 to be hurt or injured; शंभुवं मन्त्रं देवा अनेहसम् Rv. 1. 40. 6, 4, 6. 50. 3.
━m. (हा-हसौ &c.) Time (not being liable to be
 destroyed). cf. तस्मादनेहसं कंचित्प्रतीक्षस्व महाभुज Śiva B. 9. 18
 also 5. 11, 59. कुसुमबाणसखेन सुखासितं विपिनमापि न मानमनेहसा
 Rām. Ch. 4. 11.
आनेतव्य a. To be brought.
आनेय a. To be fetched.
आनेतृ a. Bringer, bringing.
